provider: Built-in image_gen; runtime does not expose the underlying model name

samples.label: A1
samples.direction: Night owl — nighttime observation and curiosity
samples.prompt:
Create one complete full-bleed 1:1 square image, approximately 1536 x 1536.
Background: fill the entire square with solid midnight navy #070b17, uniform in every open area.
Subject: one extremely simplified, cute baby owl, a curious calm night-sky companion. A round squat merged head/body shape and two rounded wing lobes, one broad continuous double-lobed facial mask. No ear tufts or sharp beak.
Complexity: 4-7 large soft geometric shapes, one continuous outer silhouette. Two simple slightly oval eyes placed within the broad mask; subtly offset both eyes towards the viewer's RIGHT, a small head yaw to the RIGHT as if attentively watching a pointer to its right. Keep both eyes visible, the overall character upright. No mouth needed. Readable at 32 x 32.
Color: exactly two subject colors: lavender #c9c1f0 body and deep muted violet #51436e broad continuous facial mask. Eyes reuse lavender. Exactly these two semantic subject colors and the midnight navy background. No extra colors.
Composition: emerge from the LOWER LEFT, occupy 85-95% of the square. Both rounded wings visible; subtle bottom/left cropping can support the corner emergence. Do not center.
Style: ultra-clean graphic simplicity, soft heavy rounded forms, baby-like proportions, endearing quiet personality. Add an extremely, extremely subtle, almost imperceptible sense of depth through a barely-there neo-skeuomorphic treatment.
Constraints: no text, watermark, frame, cards, extra subjects, props, scenery, stars, outlines, fine lines, sharp tips, costumes, texture, decorative marks, photorealistic material, glossy hotspots, strong three-dimensional rendering, external cast shadows, backdrop gradient or vignette.
